rides.title: Social Ride - Gravel 80 km | Nordic Chase 2026
rides.description:
🚴‍♂️ Nordic Chase: Gravel Social Ride (80 km)
Join us for a Social Ride in the spirit of the legendary Nordic Chase! We’re heading out to tackle the first 40 km of the official Copenhagen-to-Oslo Gravel Edition route, then looping back for a well-deserved caffeine fix.

This is a social ride, but we’ll be moving at a steady pace to keep things spicy. Expect a morning of prime gravel, good company, and great coffee.

📍 The Details
- GRAVEL RIDE
- When: Saturday, May 16th
- Meetup: 08:25 AM
- Roll-out: 08:30 AM Sharp ⏱️
- Start Point: GoNordic Cruiseline HQ (Official Race Start)
- Distance: ~80 km
- Pace: 27–28 km/h (approx. 3 hours of riding)
- Finish: ~12:00 PM at Kliché Værksted (Islands Brygge) for coffee and post-ride chats.

🛠️ What You Need to Know

Group Size: Limited to 20 riders. We will split into smaller groups on the road to ensure safety.

Please bring:
- Enough water and snacks to fuel 3 hours of effort.
- A flat kit in case of punctures.

⚠️ Note: Please ensure you have the route downloaded to your head unit.

Weather Policy: We’re here for the fun, not the suffer-fest. If it rains, the event is cancelled. Check this event page at 07:00 AM on the day for the final go/no-go.

🗺️ The Route
We follow the official Nordic Chase Gravel Edition outbound for 40 km before turning back toward the city.

Ready to chase? Hit 'Going' to secure your spot—first come, first served!

rides.title: Road Ride
rides.description:
Join us for our Long Road Ride — a longer endurance outing with intermittent efforts along the route. We'll ride as a group and split into smaller groups for the loops, and always regroup afterwards. Depending on numbers of participents we will split up in two groups. Grouping and splits will be based on pace and fitness. Riders will rotate turns at the front throughout the ride. Always download the route to your headunit. Target average speed: 30–32 km/h. Participants should be comfortable riding in a group and familiar with standard hand and verbal signals. We usually finish at the shop for a drink or something to eat. 

If you have any questions please reach out. Looking forward seeing you!

Meeting Point: Århusgade 126, 2150 Nordhavn
Meeting time: 09.15
Start time: 09.30
Distance: 100-120 km +/-
Pace: 30- 32 km/h
Surface: Road
____________________
Bring a spare tube/plugs/tools, ride food and hydration. For everyone's safety, please obey all traffic lights and signs. If you have any questions do not hesitate to ask the rider leader at the event. And please download the route before the ride. Please "attend" if you intend to join the event.

rides.title: Women's Bakery Intermediate Ride
rides.description:
Join us on May 16th for this Women's Bakery Intermediate Ride! 

Meet up: 09:15 at Rapha Copenhagen
Departure 09:30
Pace: 28+/-kmh

Led by our team of Rapha Ride Leaders, this ride will take you on a 72km loop heading north before returning along the coast. We'll make a bakery stop at the 54km mark at Søly in Vedbæk. We will finish together at the Rapha Copenhagen Clubhouse. 

Free coffee will be served before and after the ride at the Rapha Copenhagen Clubhouse to all riders.

Please ensure you are familiar with group riding including hand and voice signals before joining. 

Requirements for joining:

- Road bike with clip-in pedals.
- Spare inner-tube and CO2 or mini pump.
- Appropriate clothing for the weather
- Bike helmet
- Experience riding in a group. 

Please also remember a form of payment to purchase your bakery goodies. 

We look forward to riding with you!

Hybrid Social+ Ride x Original Coffee (Pace 27-29)
DIRTY SUNDAY
rides.description:
Dirty Sunday – Gravel in Northern Zealand
Distance: 80 or 130 km - (Early Bird until 15.01.2026)

Dirty Sunday offers the perfect gravel route in Northern Zealand, featuring wide gravel roads, deep woodland sections, and rolling farm tracks. We welcome all riders — from the fast boys and girls chasing the front to those here to enjoy the scenery and maybe spend a little extra time at the midway shooting range for a chance to win one of the day’s prizes.

We once again invite you to a full-scale gravel celebration. Starting from Teglovnen Nordsjælland, we have everything we need to create a true festival atmosphere around one of Zealand’s biggest gravel events.

We’ve put a lot of effort into designing a safe and well-marked route with route marshals at key points, traffic officials, and barriers where needed.

Professional photographers will be on course to capture the energy before, during, and after the race.

Before the race: Free coffee for everyone.

After the race: Food from the grill, beer from a Danish brewery, ice cream, and all the cake and coffee you can consume.

🥃🎯 Whiskey & Gun Range Gravel
At km 90, you get the chance to take home the biggest prizes of the day.
Hit the bullseye and grab a whiskey shot on your way back to the finish 🤠

Read more about the race here: https://www.sportstiming.dk/event/17257

One final 43 km spin before the big push to Copenhagen!

This ride is all about the ice breaker. Use these miles to meet the riders you’ll be chasing (and drafting) over the next few days. It’s also the perfect time for a final equipment test—better to catch a rattling bag or a gear tweak today than tomorrow morning!

📍 The Details

When: Friday, June 5th, 2026

Meetup: 3:30 PM

Roll-out: 3:30 PM Sharp ⏱️

Start Point: Standert Bicycles (Official Race Start)

Distance: ~43 km (Social shake out)

Pace: 27–28 km/h

Finish: Back at Standert for the Rider Briefing & Pasta Party 🍝

🛠️ What You Need to Know

Groups: We will split into smaller groups on the road to keep things safe.

Navigation: Please ensure you have the route downloaded to your head unit. ⚠️

Kit: Bring a flat kit for punctures and your best post-taper vibes.

The Pasta Party 🍝
We’ll finish up back at the shop for the official briefing and a pasta feed to fuel the journey ahead.

Sign Up:
If you’re not officially on the roster for the race to Copenhagen yet, head to:

👉 www.nordicchase.com

See you at the shop! ✌️

rides.title: Berlin to Copenhagen - Road Edition - Part of Nordic Chase 2026 (Ultra Cycling Series)
rides.description:
The Nordic Chase is expanding!
We’re launching a brand-new race in 2026: Berlin → Copenhagen.

For this race we are partnering with Standert as host partner in Berlin.

The route takes riders through Germany and Denmark, passing historic towns, rolling farmland, dense forests, and scenic coastal roads — finishing in the Capital of Denmark.

🔘 Official Dotwatcher.cc event
📍 Live tracking via FollowMyChallenge.com

Registrations are open:
👉 www.nordicchase.com
(limited capacity at 100 riders)

Registration includes:
1. Rider briefing and Pasta Party @Standert Bicycles (store in Berlin)
2. Official Race Manual with the race details 
3. Race cap and other goodies
4. Live GPS tracking
5. Finisher Certificate
6. Post-ride ceremony with drinks in Copenhagen
7. Photos taken by our media team
8. Entry to WhatsApp group chat to connect other riders
9. Small bag transfer rom the start to the finish

Register on https://nordicchase.com/ber-cph-road

Questions, then email to info@nordicchase.com

Please note: The final route and exact start location in Berlin will be provided in the race manual. The current route is a draft and will be verified by the organizer. The manual will be emailed to all registered participants three weeks before the race.
